context.transcript:
What did you think of my presentation?
A. No, not this time.
B. I was at another meeting.
C. 20 pages long.
context.transcript_translation:
你觉得我的演示怎么样？
A. 不，这次不行。
B. 我在另一个会议上。
C. 20页长。

items.question: What did you think of my presentation?
items.answer_explain: 原文依据：问句或陈述是“What did you think of my presentation?”，自然应答是“I was at another meeting.”。选择理由：该项在语义和会话功能上直接承接前句；其余选项只是词汇相关、时态不合或答非所问。正确答案：B（I was at another meeting.）。
